question: The Logo of 36th National Games of India contains a Picture of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lion.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **36th National Games of India **were scheduled to be held in **Goa in 2020** but were postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• The logo of the National Games of India features a **blue and orange lion **with the number **36** written in bold letters.
 
• Lions are often associated with **strength, power, and courage**, making them a fitting symbol for a national sporting event.
 
• The use of a lion in the logo also represents India's rich cultural heritage, as the animal has significant** symbolism **in Hindu mythology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **37th National Games of India** are another name for the **2023** edition of the competition.
 
• They took place in the state of **Goa** from October 25, 2023, to November 9, 2023.
 
• In June 2023, the games' official logo and mascot, an** Indian bison named Moga**, were announced.
 
• The** Raja Bhalindra Singh Trophy, **which is given to the team with the most gold medals at the National Games, was won by **Maharashtra,** who also led the medal count in the 2023 National Games.
